== Understand ==
Tokyo is a huge city. District pages hold most listings.

=== Climate ===
The rainy season is in June and July.

== Get in ==
Most visitors arrive via Narita or Haneda.

== Get around ==
The Yamanote Line loops around central Tokyo.

== See ==
Individual attractions are listed on the district pages.

For restaurant listings, see the district articles.
